skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of unstructured data, NoSQL databases, and types of NoSQL databases.
Apply MongoDB in designing software applications, especially intelligent applications.
Apply Neo4j, Redis, and Cassandra databases in designing software applications, especially intelligent applications.
Execute code snippets, queries, and exercises assigned by the instructor.
Efficiently search, collect, synthesize, analyze, and present solutions to problems related to unstructured databases.
Collaborate with team members to solve group assignments, ensuring timely completion of group tasks.
Respond to questions posed by the instructor, complete class and homework assignments.
Participate in group discussions to solve problems and defend personal opinions before the group.
Complete projects assigned by the instructor, collaborate effectively with team members to finish tasks.
